physicalNotes: Radius 72 +/- 12 solar radii from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, period relations for Galactic fundamental-mode Cepheids applied to this star's period, 11.854 d in Hoffmann et al. (2016), ApJ 830, 10, table 5; not a measurement of this star: eq. 2, log R = 0.721 log P + 1.083; the uncertainty is the relation's scatter, 0.067 dex (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186): 50,090,400 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5270 +/- 317 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, period relations for Galactic fundamental-mode Cepheids applied to this star's period, 11.854 d in Hoffmann et al. (2016), ApJ 830, 10, table 5; not a measurement of this star: the luminosity of eq. 1 (M_bol = -2.95 log P - 0.98, with the nominal solar M_bol 4.74) over the radius of eq. 2, through L = 4 pi R^2 sigma T^4 with the nominal solar 5772 K (IAU 2015 Resolutions B2 (Mamajek et al. 2015, arXiv:1510.06262) and B3 (Prsa et al. 2016, arXiv:1605.09788)); the uncertainty is the 317 K by which the two relations miss the paper's own temperatures of its Cepheids (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
